items.label: Premium Durable Construction
items.value: Expertly crafted with a die-cast aluminum frame and tempered glass, this outdoor wall light fixtures undergoes strict electrophoretic treatment for superior waterproof, rust-proof, and corrosion-resistant performance—ideal for all weather conditions.

items.label: Versatile Modern Design
items.value: Boasting a sleek and elegant look, this outdoor porch light is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use and decors. Perfect for porches, garages, patios, garden，yard，balcony,and entryways, and more. Note: hardwired installation required—must be connected to a junction box.

items.label: E26 Heat-Resistant Socket
items.value: Our outdoor sconce light Features an E26 socket compatible with all standard E26 bulbs(MAX 60W). Supports various bulb types and color temperatures, allowing you to customize lighting mood and ambiance with ease. Note: Bulb not included

items.label: Convenient Open Base Design
items.value: The open base structure allows quick and tool-free bulb replacement. Plus, enjoy peace of mind with our reliable customer support—we stand behind our product and resolve any quality issues.

items.label: Quick & Easy Installation
items.value: Comes pre-assembled with all necessary mounting accessories and a clear instruction manual included. Save time and simplify your setup with our user-friendly design.

items.label: Specific Uses for Product
items.value: Balcony, Driveway, Garage, Garden, Home, Patio, Porch/Doorway, Street Lighting, Yard
